seo.title: Best Vegan Restaurants in Casablanca (2026) | tabiji.ai
seo.metaDescription: Discover Casablanca's top vegan restaurants, from healthy acai bowls to authentic Moroccan tagines and gourmet burgers. Find the best spots for every budget and occasion in Morocco's vibrant city.

hero.subtitle: Casablanca's culinary scene is rapidly embracing plant-based dining, offering a diverse array of vegan-friendly options that blend traditional Moroccan flavors with international culinary trends. From bustling cafes to upscale dining, finding delicious vegan meals is becoming easier than ever.

picks.name: L'Organic Kitchen
picks.whyItMadeTheList: L'Organic Kitchen is a true gem for health-conscious diners, offering a menu rich in organic and locally sourced ingredients. While not exclusively vegan, their extensive selection of plant-based dishes, from vibrant salads to hearty mains and delicious vegan desserts, makes it a top choice. The bright, airy atmosphere complements its fresh food philosophy.
picks.whatToOrder: The 'Green Power Bowl' with quinoa, avocado, various greens, and a tahini dressing, or their daily vegan tart.
picks.insiderTip: Go for brunch on a weekend for a relaxed atmosphere and a wider selection of freshly baked vegan pastries.
picks.redditQuote: "L'Organic Kitchen seriously saved me in Casablanca. Their vegan options are so fresh and actually flavorful, not just an afterthought. Highly recommend the power bowls!"

picks.name: Acai Spot
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Perfect for a healthy start to your day or a refreshing lunch, Acai Spot specializes in vibrant acai bowls, smoothies, and nourishing toasts. Most of their menu is naturally vegan or easily adaptable, making it a go-to for quick, delicious plant-based fuel. It's a casual, friendly spot ideal for a light meal.
picks.whatToOrder: The 'Classic Acai Bowl' with fresh fruits and granola, or an 'Avocado Toast' on whole-wheat bread.
picks.insiderTip: They have multiple locations across Casablanca; check their nearest one for convenience, as they can get busy during peak hours.
picks.redditQuote: "Couldn't start my day without an Acai Spot bowl in Casablanca. So good and totally vegan-friendly. Plus, the coffee is great!"

picks.name: BFF (Burger Frites Forever)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Who says vegans can't enjoy a hearty burger? BFF crafts some of the city's best gourmet burgers, and their dedicated vegan option is a standout. Using a delicious plant-based patty and fresh toppings, it’s a satisfying and flavorful experience. The vibe is modern and lively, perfect for a casual meal with friends.
picks.whatToOrder: The 'Vegan Supreme Burger' with a side of sweet potato fries.
picks.insiderTip: Ask for their homemade vegan sauces to perfectly complement your burger and fries.
picks.redditQuote: "Seriously impressed with BFF's vegan burger. It's not just a sad veggie patty; it's a proper, delicious gourmet burger. A must-try if you're craving one in Casablanca!"

picks.name: N'Thai
picks.whyItMadeTheList: N'Thai offers an authentic journey into Thai cuisine, known for its vibrant flavors and aromatic spices. Many traditional Thai dishes are naturally vegan or can be easily adapted by substituting tofu or vegetables for meat and ensuring no fish sauce. Their curries and noodle dishes are packed with fresh ingredients.
picks.whatToOrder: Vegetable Green Curry with tofu (ensure no fish sauce) or Pad See Ew with tofu.
picks.insiderTip: Specify 'no fish sauce' and 'no oyster sauce' when ordering to guarantee your meal is fully vegan. The staff are usually very accommodating.
picks.redditQuote: "The vegan options at N'Thai are surprisingly good! Their green curry with tofu was spot on, just remember to be clear about 'no fish sauce'."

picks.name: O'wok
picks.whyItMadeTheList: O'wok provides a fun, interactive dining experience where you can customize your own wok dish from a wide array of fresh ingredients. This makes it incredibly easy to create a delicious and satisfying vegan meal. Choose your base (rice, noodles), vegetables, protein (tofu), and vegan sauce, and watch it cooked fresh.
picks.whatToOrder: A custom wok with rice noodles, mixed vegetables, tofu, and a peanut or soy-ginger sauce.
picks.insiderTip: Clearly specify 'vegan' to the chef, and they will guide you through the sauce options that are plant-based.
picks.redditQuote: "O'wok is my go-to for a quick, customizable vegan meal in Casablanca. You literally build your own, so it's impossible to mess up being vegan!"

picks.name: La Sqala
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Set within the ancient walls of a beautifully restored 18th-century bastion, La Sqala offers an enchanting Moroccan dining experience. While traditional Moroccan cuisine often features meat, their vegetable tagines, couscous, and extensive salad selections can be hearty and flavorful vegan options. The lush garden setting adds to its unique charm.
picks.whatToOrder: Vegetable Tagine (confirm no animal broth or butter) or a platter of Moroccan salads and 'Zaalouk' (eggplant dip).
picks.insiderTip: Make a reservation, especially for dinner, and clearly communicate your dietary needs in advance to ensure the kitchen can accommodate you fully.
picks.redditQuote: "La Sqala's ambiance is incredible, and I was pleasantly surprised by how good their vegetable tagine was. Just make sure to ask for it fully vegan!"

picks.name: The Brunch Factory
picks.whyItMadeTheList: As its name suggests, The Brunch Factory is a popular spot for breakfast and lunch, offering a trendy, comfortable atmosphere. While not exclusively vegan, their menu features many international brunch staples like avocado toast, fruit bowls, and salads, which can easily be made vegan or are already plant-based. It's a great spot for a relaxed morning.
picks.whatToOrder: Avocado Toast (ask for no egg/dairy) with a fresh fruit smoothie, or a customized 'build your own' salad.
picks.insiderTip: They can get very busy on weekends, so arrive early or be prepared for a short wait.
picks.redditQuote: "The Brunch Factory has some surprisingly good vegan options if you're into avocado toast or fruit bowls. Perfect for a chill Sunday morning."

picks.name: Roots Moroccan Kitchen
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Roots Moroccan Kitchen brings a fresh, modern twist to traditional Moroccan flavors, with a strong emphasis on seasonal and locally sourced ingredients. They are very conscious about dietary needs and offer several creative plant-based dishes that go beyond the typical tagine, showcasing the richness of Moroccan produce. The decor is chic and earthy.
picks.whatToOrder: The 'Vegetable and Chickpea Harira' (ensure no meat broth) and their daily special vegan main, often a creative take on a traditional stew.
picks.insiderTip: Speak with the chef or staff about daily vegan specials, as they often have off-menu options based on market availability.
picks.redditQuote: "Roots Moroccan Kitchen is amazing for a healthier, more modern take on Moroccan food. They have some fantastic vegan options that feel really authentic but fresh."

picks.name: Bombay Palace
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Bombay Palace delivers a rich and aromatic experience of authentic Indian cuisine. Indian food is inherently vegan-friendly, with many delicious vegetable and lentil-based curries, biryanis, and bread options. Their extensive menu provides ample choices that can be easily confirmed as vegan, offering a burst of flavor in a comfortable setting.
picks.whatToOrder: Dal Makhani (ensure no cream/butter), Aloo Gobi, Chana Masala, and vegan Roti (flatbread).
picks.insiderTip: Clearly state 'vegan' and ask for dishes cooked without ghee, butter, or cream. The staff are knowledgeable and can guide you.
picks.redditQuote: "Bombay Palace is a lifesaver for vegans in Casablanca. So many delicious curries, just ask for no dairy and you're set. The chana masala is heavenly."

picks.name: Senza Glutine
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Senza Glutine is a haven for those with dietary restrictions, specializing in gluten-free dishes. Beyond gluten, they are also excellent at accommodating other needs, including veganism. Their menu features a range of healthy, freshly prepared items, from salads and bowls to gluten-free pasta and baked goods, with clearly marked or adaptable vegan choices.
picks.whatToOrder: Gluten-free pasta with a fresh tomato basil sauce and roasted vegetables, or a custom-made vegan salad.
picks.insiderTip: Don't hesitate to ask about their daily vegan dessert options, as they often have surprising and delicious gluten-free and vegan treats.
picks.redditQuote: "Found Senza Glutine and it's fantastic for both gluten-free and vegan options. Super safe and delicious, finally a place I can eat everything with peace of mind!"

picks.name: Le Cabestan Ocean View
picks.whyItMadeTheList: For an unforgettable dining experience, Le Cabestan offers breathtaking ocean views and a sophisticated ambiance. While known for its seafood, this upscale establishment is adept at crafting exquisite vegan dishes upon request, showcasing high-quality produce and creative culinary techniques. It's the perfect spot for a special occasion or a luxurious evening out.
picks.whatToOrder: A custom-prepared vegetable risotto (ensure no butter/cheese), or a beautifully plated seasonal vegetable and grain dish by request.
picks.insiderTip: Make a reservation well in advance and clearly inform them of your vegan dietary requirements. They appreciate the heads-up to prepare something truly special.
picks.redditQuote: "Le Cabestan created a custom vegan entree for me, and it was incredible. The view alone is worth it, but they really delivered on the food despite being known for seafood."

picks.name: The Kozy Bar & Restaurant
picks.whyItMadeTheList: The Kozy Bar & Restaurant is a popular, trendy spot known for its vibrant atmosphere and diverse international menu. While not exclusively vegan, their modern approach to cuisine means they are flexible and can adapt many dishes to be plant-based. You'll find creative salads, adaptable pasta dishes, and often a dedicated vegetarian section with veganizable options.
picks.whatToOrder: A 'Buddha Bowl' (confirm vegan dressing) or a custom vegetable pasta with a marinara sauce.
picks.insiderTip: Visit during happy hour for great drink deals and inquire about any off-menu vegan specials they might have.
picks.redditQuote: "The Kozy Bar had some great vibes and surprisingly good vegan options for a trendy spot. Their 'Buddha Bowl' was super satisfying after a day of exploring."

faq.question: Is Casablanca a vegan-friendly city?
faq.answer: While not traditionally a vegan hub, Casablanca is increasingly accommodating plant-based diets. With a growing number of international restaurants, health-focused cafes, and establishments willing to adapt dishes, finding delicious vegan meals has become significantly easier, especially in modern neighborhoods like Anfa and Gauthier.

faq.question: What are common accidentally vegan Moroccan dishes?
faq.answer: Traditional Moroccan cuisine offers several naturally vegan options. Vegetable tagines (ensure no animal broth or butter), various Moroccan salads like Zaalouk (eggplant dip) and Taktouka (cooked pepper and tomato salad), and certain types of Harira soup (verify no meat broth) are often vegan-friendly. Always confirm ingredients with your server.

faq.question: How do I communicate being vegan in Casablanca?
faq.answer: Learning a few key phrases in Darija (Moroccan Arabic) or French can be very helpful. In French, you can say 'Je suis végétalien(ne)' (I am vegan) and 'Sans viande, sans poisson, sans produits laitiers, sans oeufs' (Without meat, without fish, without dairy products, without eggs). Most restaurant staff in tourist areas or higher-end establishments will understand English.

faq.question: Are there dedicated vegan restaurants in Casablanca?
faq.answer: While fully dedicated vegan restaurants are less common than in some Western cities, Casablanca has several vegetarian-friendly establishments and cafes with extensive vegan options. Many places, particularly those focused on healthy eating or international cuisine, are well-versed in plant-based dining and can cater to vegan diets.

faq.question: Can I find vegan groceries in Casablanca?
faq.answer: Yes, major supermarkets like Marjane and Carrefour in Casablanca offer a good selection of plant-based staples, including fresh produce, legumes, grains, and increasingly, vegan alternatives like plant milks, tofu, and meat substitutes. Organic shops and health food stores also stock specialized vegan products.

faq.question: What is the typical price range for vegan meals in Casablanca?
faq.answer: The price range for vegan meals in Casablanca varies widely. You can find budget-friendly options like acai bowls or simple Moroccan salads for 60-120 MAD ($6-12). Mid-range restaurants offering vegan burgers or curries typically cost 100-200 MAD ($10-20), while upscale dining experiences with vegan options can range from 250-600+ MAD ($25-60+).

methodology: Our selection for the best vegan restaurants in Casablanca is based on extensive local research, diner reviews, and expert recommendations. We prioritized establishments known for their dedicated vegan menus, exceptional plant-based adaptations, and commitment to fresh, high-quality ingredients, ensuring a diverse range of culinary experiences for every preference.
